scientific.integrity: The primary full PDF was inspected at the continuous model, denominator function, nonlocal update, disease-free Jacobian, stability theorem, global-stability section, and numerical comparison. A later NSFD full PDF was inspected at its definition of elementary stability. The bundled symbolic checker verifies the multiplier floor, crossover, asymptotics, and exact witness. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The finding concerns the disease-free infected linear mode and the source's nonlocal update architecture. It does not invalidate positivity, equilibrium preservation, qualitative local/global stability, or establish nonlinear transient-error bounds away from the disease-free state.

title: A sharp infection-decay floor in an unconditionally stable NSFD SIR scheme
